about_the_game: This is a highly random card-drawing 3D battle game. Players strengthen themselves through encounters on the road and draw cards every round. The game is highly random, and each time is a new game. The game background is on the edge of an island. In the 3D scene, the waves keep hitting, and the players keep hitting monsters and bosses with the cards in their hands.During the game, each small battle will make you stronger. At the same time, there will be different adventures in the game process. Strengthen yourself. The game scene is on the edge of an island. After winning, you will get "fate", and through "fate" you can continue to draw stronger adventures.
